svg.title: VO2max against age
svg.desc: Line chart of the default VO2max as a multiple of its value at age 35. It holds at 1.02 up to 25, is 1.00 at 35, 0.94 at 45, 0.88 at 55, 0.81 at 65 and 0.72 at 75, reaching about 0.67 at 80: a gentle loss into the fifties that speeds up after. A dashed straight line for population averages, falling about a tenth per decade, reaches 0.60 at 75 and sits below the Runsketch curve at every age past 35.
